ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes (~65%) relative to low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the central axis and peduncle attachment (~35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity black mass extending from the peduncle to the median notch with irregular, feathered borders. High-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the outer two-thirds of both the left and right lobes. High-frequency black-pixel mottling is concentrated at the interior interface of the white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire margin; peak-to-valley amplitudes vary from 3 to 12 pixels, appearing most jagged on the medial sections of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curve originating at the median notch and sweeping towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (dark spots) scattered across the high-intensity white regions, particularly on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-white region of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue loss/indentation on the far right distal tip, creating a non-symmetrical terminus relative to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Specular highlights and water droplet occlusion present on the extreme right tip and along segments of the trailing edge due to active water shedding.
